rules.title: Tenant Protection Act of 2019 (Civil Code section 1946.2)
rules.requirement: Statewide just cause is required to terminate a residential tenancy, but the section does not apply where a local just cause ordinance adopted on or before September 1, 2019 applies, or where a later local ordinance is more protective (consistent just cause, further limits or higher relocation, and a binding finding of being more protective). Property cannot be subject to both; less protective later local ordinances are unenforceable unless this section is repealed. Waivers are void, and the section does not apply to mobilehome owners.
rules.status_basis: Amended by Stats. 2025, Ch. 203, Sec. 1 (AB 1529), effective January 1, 2026; operative April 1, 2024 per subdivision (m); repealed as of January 1, 2030 by its own provisions.

requires.name: residential_real_property
requires.text: any dwelling or unit that is intended for human habitation, including any dwelling or unit in a mobilehome park

exempt_if.name: local_ordinance_pre_2019
exempt_if.text: Residential real property subject to a local ordinance requiring just cause for termination of a residential tenancy adopted on or before September 1, 2019

exempt_if.name: local_ordinance_more_protective
exempt_if.text: Residential real property subject to a local ordinance requiring just cause adopted or amended after September 1, 2019, that is more protective than this section

exempt_if.name: mobilehome_homeowner
exempt_if.text: This section shall not apply to a homeowner of a mobilehome, as defined in Section 798.9.

coverage.summary: Applies to any dwelling or unit intended for human habitation, including in mobilehome parks.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Exempt where a qualifying local just cause ordinance applies, and for mobilehome homeowners.

precedence.text: A local ordinance adopted or amended after September 1, 2019 that is more protective than this section applies; a less protective one shall not be enforced unless this section is repealed.

rules.quoted_span: A residential real property shall not be subject to both a local ordinance requiring just cause for termination of a residential tenancy and this section.
